$comment: engine.tourism (MOD-057, §44; §21 lets) — the holiday-tourism balance data contract. §44 describes the visitor economy by DIRECTION and mechanism only (the draw formula's terms and multipliers, the accommodation-stock caps, the reputation-fragile seasonal income); it gives NO tuned magnitude for the access-tier reach ladder, the reputation→multiplier scale/lag, the visitor rates, the per-kind starter bed stock, or the load/spend coefficients. Every numeric value here is therefore a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass (the standing balance-number regime, GR#15): tests assert direction/structure only (summer peaks, a higher access rung out-reaches a lower one, a capacity cap binds, the August queue drains), never a pinned figure. The one mechanism-relevant figure is reputationLagMonths (AC-10's lag window) — a v1 default, see ASM-319. All maps are only ever ACCESSED by key (never ranged), so JSON object-key order is irrelevant to determinism (GR#21).
